name: του Κόκκινου ('The Red One')
facts: Highest spring. Its communal open-air cistern is privately owned; water runs on to the plot of spring 2 and a secondary cistern; overflow rights there are oral. One plot's contract gives water twice a week from this cistern
Lies on a plot below spring 1, with a secondary cistern fed from spring 1's cistern
A communal cistern near it (one of five)

name: 'Flea' (or 'Vein')
facts: Communal cistern on private land, treated as communal; gives 14 waters a week (every 12-hour span) to plots below, shared by five families; flow steadier and larger than the others; rights written in the contracts
Under berry bushes. Two cisterns, one open-air and one closed; overflow piped to a cistern two terraces below, whose plot has one water a week by contract; drain-off rights unwritten
A communal cistern near it (one of five)
Nearest the sea of the nine in the chapter's aerial figure (13.3)
